name: chat-feed
title: Chat feed
description: The conversation: the person's messages with their chips, the agent's words (interim, then the reply), a change chip for each board write, approval cards settled in place and system lines; under it one quiet status line while the agent works. Tools never show raw (PLAN ruling 6).

files.core: feed-core.ts (applyEvent, applyEvents, EMPTY_CHAT, ChatState, FeedEntry, activityLine, changeLabel, atBottom, leavesLatest, followAfterScroll; no DOM)

attributes.data-busy: true while a turn runs (set by show)
attributes.data-following: false once the person scrolled away from the latest; true by default

methods.configure(o): render (the host's Markdown renderer), boardName (a board's title for change chips), empty, label, clock
methods.show(state): draws the state from the core: adds and redraws only new or changed entries (an unchanged entry is the same object), follows the latest (a ResizeObserver keeps the view at the end while following; the panel opening shows the latest), ticks open approvals every second
methods.follow(): follow the latest again and show it (the host calls it when the person sends)
methods.answerFailed(approvalId, message): the answer did not go through: its card says why and takes clicks again

events: chat-change (bubbles): detail { board, cards, head? }, a change chip clicked; the host shows the cards
whenToUse: The words of one chat session, beside the board or in another host.
whenNotToUse: The board's own history (the ledger), or anything a tool returned raw.
accessibility: The log is role=log, polite, named 'Conversation' and focusable so it scrolls by keyboard. Each message starts with a hidden 'You:' or 'Agent:'. The status line is role=status, outside the log. Change chips are buttons. Jump to latest is a labelled button, hidden while following.
